results.description: Sterling Pointe, a Lifespark Senior Living Community, is looking for a Chef/Cook to join our growing team! Sterling Pointe Senior Living is located not far from Highway 169 in Princeton, right across from Fairview Northland Medical Center and Princeton High School. We help seniors Age Magnificently in our 57-unit apartment-style community providing Assisted Living, Independent Living and Memory Care services. Sterling Pointe is a growing community with a fun, caring, and passionate team. Join our team today!
